You are an agent who can operate an Android phone on behalf of a user. Based on user's goal/request, you may
- Answer back if the request/goal is a question (or a chat message), like user asks "What is my schedule for today?".
- Complete some tasks described in the requests/goals by performing actions (step by step) on the phone.

When given a user request, you will try to complete it step by step. At each step, a list of descriptions for most UI elements on the current screen will be given to you (each element can be specified by an index), together with a history of what you have done in previous steps. Based on these pieces of information and the goal, you must choose to perform one of the action in the following list (action description followed by the JSON format) by outputing the action in the correct JSON format.
- If you think the task has been completed, finish the task by using the status action with complete as goal_status: `{"action_type": "status", "goal_status": "complete"}`
- If you think the task is not feasible (including cases like you don't have enough information or can not perform some necessary actions), finish by using the `status` action with infeasible as goal_status: `{"action_type": "status", "goal_status": "infeasible"}`
- Answer user's question: `{"action_type": "answer", "text": "<answer_text>"}`
- Click/tap on a UI element (specified by its index) on the screen: `{"action_type": "click", "index": <target_index>}`.
- Long press on a UI element (specified by its index) on the screen: `{"action_type": "long_press", "index": <target_index>}`.
- Type text into an editable text field (specified by its index), this action contains clicking the text field, typing in the text and pressing the enter, so no need to click on the target field to start: `{"action_type": "input_text", "text": <text_input>, "index": <target_index>}`
- Press the Enter key: `{"action_type": "keyboard_enter"}`
- Navigate to the home screen: `{"action_type": "navigate_home"}`
- Navigate back: `{"action_type": "navigate_back"}`
- Scroll the screen or a scrollable UI element in one of the four directions, use the same numeric index as above if you want to scroll a specific UI element, leave it empty when scroll the whole screen: `{"action_type": "scroll", "direction": <up, down, left, right>, "index": <optional_target_index>}`
- Open an app (nothing will happen if the app is not installed): `{"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": <name>}`
- Wait for the screen to update: `{"action_type": "wait"}`

The current user goal/request is: Merge the contents of Markor notes 2023_07_22_sure_ant.md, 2023_08_02_happy_cat.txt and DmMi_witty_king.md (in the same order) into a new Markor note named xQXRBI02 and save it. Add a new line between the content of each note.

Here is a history of what you have done so far:
Step 1: Action selected: {"action_type": "open_app", "app_name": "Markor"}. Opened the Markor app successfully. The main file list is now visible, showing the three target notes: 2023_07_22_sure_ant.md, 2023_08_02_happy_cat.txt, and DmMi_witty_king.md. Next, I need to open each note to copy its content, then create the new note xQXRBI02 and paste them in order with new lines between.
Step 2: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 13}. Clicked on "2023_07_22_sure_ant.md" to open it, and the file opened successfully showing its content "8d7ctr0eXvbV1syGivQF" in the editor.
Step 3: Action selected: {"action_type": "long_press", "index": 8}. Long-pressed the editor to bring up the text selection toolbar, which now shows "Select all" and "More options" as expected.
Step 4: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 18}. Clicked "Select all" to select the entire content of the first note (2023_07_22_sure_ant) in the editor, preparing to copy it.
Step 5: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 63}. Tapped "Copy" on the text selection toolbar to copy the content "8d7ctr0eXvbV1syGivQF" of the first note (2023_07_22_sure_ant.md) to the clipboard.
Step 6: Output for action selection is not in the correct format, so no action is performed.
Step 7: Action selected: {"action_type": "navigate_back"}. Pressed back to go to file list, but only dismissed the keyboard; still in the note editor. Need another back to exit note.
Step 8: Action selected: {"action_type": "navigate_back"}. Navigated back from the note editor to the file list, where all three target notes are now visible.
Step 9: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 1}. Tapped the 'Create a new file or folder' button (FAB) to open the new file dialog. The dialog appeared, ready to enter the file name.
Step 10: Action selected: {"action_type": "input_text", "text": "xQXRBI02", "index": 1}. Typed the filename "xQXRBI02" into the name field (replacing "my_note"); extension remains .md. The new file dialog is now correctly set for creation.
Step 11: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 11}. Clicked OK in new file dialog, creating and opening note "xQXRBI02.md" for editing; ready to paste content.
Step 12: Action selected: {"action_type": "long_press", "index": 8}. Long press on editor area (index 8) successfully brought up context menu with "Paste" option (index 61), ready to paste the clipboard content of the first note.
Step 13: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 60}. Pasted the content of 2023_07_22_sure_ant.md ("8d7ctr0eXvbV1syGivQF") into the new note xQXRBI02 via the Paste button; success.
Step 14: Action selected: {"action_type": "navigate_back"}. Pressed navigate back intending to exit the editor and go to file list, but action only dismissed the keyboard; editor remained open with same content (no navigation occurred). Will need a different approach to leave editor.
Step 15: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 4}. Clicked Save on the note xQXRBI02 (currently holding the first note's content) to persist progress; save succeeded (Save button now disabled). Next, navigate back to the file list to copy the second note.
Step 16: Action selected: {"action_type": "navigate_back"}. Navigated back from the xQXRBI02 editor to the file list successfully; now all source notes and the target file are visible.
Step 17: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 14}. Opened the second note "2023_08_02_happy_cat.txt" to view its content: "Gfr6qjMS77iUukXZ3eH6\n". The editor opened successfully.
Step 18: Action selected: {"action_type": "long_press", "index": 8}. Long-pressed the editor area (index 8) on the note "2023_08_02_happy_cat" to bring up the text selection toolbar; the paste/select-all menu appeared as expected, so the next step can be to select all and copy the note's content.
Step 19: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 19}. "Tapped 'Select all' to select the entire content of the second note; text is now selected and copy/cut options are available."
Step 20: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 63}. Clicked the Copy button to copy the text of 2023_08_02_happy_cat.txt to clipboard; a system clipboard overlay appeared confirming the text was copied successfully.
Step 21: Action selected: {"action_type": "navigate_back"}. Pressed back to dismiss keyboard, still in the editor for 2023_08_02_happy_cat.txt; need one more back to reach file list.
Step 22: Action selected: {"action_type": "navigate_back"}. Navigated back from 2023_08_02_happy_cat.txt editor to Markor file list; all source notes and an existing xQXRBI02.md are visible. Next: open DmMi_witty_king.md to copy its content.
Step 23: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 16}. Clicked on xQXRBI02.md to open it, but the screen remained unchanged (still file list); the file likely didn't open, so may need to wait or tap again.
Step 24: Output for action selection is not in the correct format, so no action is performed.
Step 25: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 8}. Clicked on the editor (index 8) to bring up the keyboard; the keyboard appeared and the editor area shrank, with content unchanged, ready for input.
Step 26: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 59}. Pressed Enter to insert an additional newline after the first note's content; the editor now contains "8d7ctr0eXvbV1syGivQF\n\n" and Undo is enabled, ready for pasting the next note.
Step 27: Output for action selection is not in the correct format, so no action is performed.
Step 28: Action selected: {"action_type": "long_press", "index": 8}. Long-pressed the editor to bring up the context menu; menu appeared with Paste, Select all, and More options, ready to paste the second note's content.
Step 29: Action selected: {"action_type": "click", "index": 60}. Clicked the Paste button; the clipboard content (second note) was inserted after the first note with newlines, successfully merging the first two notes.

Here are some useful guidelines you need to follow:
General
- Usually there will be multiple ways to complete a task, pick the easiest one. Also when something does not work as expected (due to various reasons), sometimes a simple retry can solve the problem, but if it doesn't (you can see that from the history), try to switch to other solutions.
- Sometimes you may need to navigate the phone to gather information needed to complete the task, for example if user asks "what is my schedule tomorrow", then you may want to open the calendar app (using the `open_app` action), look up information there, answer user's question (using the `answer` action) and finish (using the `status` action with complete as goal_status).
- For requests that are questions (or chat messages), remember to use the `answer` action to reply to user explicitly before finish! Merely displaying the answer on the screen is NOT sufficient (unless the goal is something like "show me ...").
- If the desired state is already achieved (e.g., enabling Wi-Fi when it's already on), you can just complete the task.
Action Related
- Use the `open_app` action whenever you want to open an app (nothing will happen if the app is not installed), do not use the app drawer to open an app unless all other ways have failed.
